# FileToPDF.dev

Convert files, HTML, and Markdown into PDF documents through the FileToPDF.dev API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/filetopdf/.

## Actions

- **Convert File URL to PDF**: Convert a file at a public HTTPS URL to PDF, consuming one conversion credit and returning a downloadable PDF.
- **Convert HTML to PDF**: Render an HTML string as a PDF, consuming one conversion credit and returning a downloadable PDF.
- **Convert Markdown to PDF**: Render a GitHub-Flavored Markdown string as a PDF.
- **Get Account Status** (read-only): Return the connected FileToPDF workspace plan, subscription status, and remaining conversion credits without consuming a credit.
